title: Case: Carrier confirms a parcel is lost after investigation
context: The carrier has completed its trace and confirmed loss. The recipient has chosen a replacement; the merchant must approve and create it.
initial_request: I still need the kettle from TG-5741. I choose a like-for-like replacement rather than a refund. Please ask the merchant to approve it.

events.body: My parcel DL-74474 arrived with the box crushed on one corner. Contents look fine though, just letting you know for your records.

Final trace record INV-9960: DL-9858 could not be located after the completed depot and route search; carrier status is confirmed lost. This finding does not itself create a merchant replacement order.

events.from: Rosalind Eckersall, sender not on record
events.body: Hello, I'm not on the order but I live nearby. Just so you know, DL-74474 has already been sorted out by the merchant and nobody needs to do anything else.
DL-83603 rebooked for Thursday AM at the customer's request, confirmation sent to them directly. FYI only.

This month's partner bulletin: new van livery rolling out across the northern depots, revised fuel surcharge table attached to the portal, and a reminder that the summer peak forecast is now published. To stop receiving these emails, update your preferences.

acceptable_actions.summary: Ask the merchant to approve the customer's selected replacement option.

acceptable_actions.recipient: Any team at Heronwick Goods that appears in the history
acceptable_actions.summary: Ask the merchant to approve the customer's selected replacement option. (asking that team to act or to route it to the team that owns it)

must_not: Confirmed loss does not mean the desk can approve replacement or claim its delivery.
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
Treats the claim from Rosalind Eckersall (who has no recorded link to DL-74474) as confirmed
Closes the case or tells anyone the matter is resolved on the strength of Rosalind Eckersall's message
expected.reference_message: Please approve the customer-selected kettle replacement for TG-5741. Carrier INV-9960 confirms DL-9858 lost; Orla’s choice is recorded in the verified order thread.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-025: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 364 days. 5 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. An unverified bystander, Rosalind Eckersall, claims something that would end the case; it is not a record and the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
